J1.en: J1, a wet-lab molecular biologist, takes finalist selection straight from the handbook. Finalists are the highest-ranking teams on Project, Wiki and Presentation, using a weighted average within each section (p.12, Step 8; p.28). High School gets 2 finalists, and each vote is an individual opinion (p.10). Project is "the main determinant" (p.31), but no weights are published. Presentation videos cannot be seen, so J1 records Presentation as not assessed. Panel conventions, local to the simulation: composite = 0.7 x Project mean + 0.3 x Wiki mean; Wiki is the second key and tie-breaker; if composites are within 0.25, compare a2, then a6, then a1; and a functioning-part benchmark for calibration only (no demonstrated working Part, a2 rarely above 3). J1 looks first at Results, Engineering, Measurement and the Registry: controls, replicates, labelled ladders. A 5 is pegged to GreatBay_SZ 2019 and TAS Taipei 2017 (p.32-35, p.102-104). Scores fall when claims outrun evidence, attribution is weak (a6), or figures cannot be trusted. Integrity concerns go to the RCC, not to a judge-imposed penalty (p.25).
J1.zh: J1 是濕實驗室的分子生物學家，直接依照手冊規則理解決賽隊伍的選出方式。決賽隊伍是在 Project、Wiki 與 Presentation 三個項目上排名最高的隊伍，並在各組別內以加權平均計算（p.12，Step 8；p.28）。High School 組有 2 支決賽隊伍，每一票都是評審個人的意見（p.10）。Project 是「決定決賽隊伍的主要因素」（p.31），但手冊並未公布權重。本次模擬中看不到 Presentation 影片，因此 J1 將 Presentation 記為未評分。評審小組的慣例僅適用於本次模擬，並非手冊規定：綜合分數 = 0.7 x Project 平均 + 0.3 x Wiki 平均；Wiki 作為第二順位與平手時的判斷依據；若綜合分數相差在 0.25 以內，依序比較 a2、a6、a1；另設有功能性零件（functioning Part）基準，僅供校準使用（若未展示可運作的 Part，a2 很少超過 3 分）。J1 最先查看 Results、Engineering、Measurement 與 Registry：對照組、重複次數、有標示的 ladder、經標準化的數據。5 分的標準對應 GreatBay_SZ 2019 與 TAS Taipei 2017（p.32-35、p.102-104）。當主張超出證據、貢獻歸屬（a6）薄弱，或圖表無法令人信任時，分數會下降。誠信疑慮應通報 RCC，而不是由評審自行處罰（p.25）。

J2.en: J2, a bioprocess and hardware engineer, proposes the 2 High School finalists from the handbook rule: the highest-ranking teams on Project, Wiki and Presentation, using a weighted average within the section (p.12, Step 8; p.28). Project is "the main determinant" (p.31); the weights are not published. Presentation cannot be seen, so it is not assessed, and aspect 9 stays blank (p.32). The working rank is the Project mean (a1-a8) first, with a1, a2 and a4 most decisive, then the Wiki mean (w1-w5) as tie-breaker when Project scores are close. Close calls could flip once Presentation counts. The top of the scale is GreatBay_SZ 2019 and TAS Taipei 2017 (p.32-35, p.102-104), and one well-characterised working Part is a substantial achievement (p.101). J2 looks first at DBTL (a4), standards and modularity (a7) and whether the work holds up outside the lab. Scores fall when results are only claimed, modelled or planned, when a model is decoration, or when parts are documented only on the wiki (p.18). Integrity matters go to the RCC (p.25).
J2.zh: J2 是生物製程與硬體工程師，依手冊規則提出 2 支 High School 決賽隊伍：在 Project、Wiki 與 Presentation 上排名最高的隊伍，並在組別內以加權平均計算（p.12，Step 8；p.28）。Project 是「決定決賽隊伍的主要因素」（p.31），但權重並未公布。由於看不到 Presentation，該項記為未評分，絕不自行編造分數，aspect 9 也保持空白（p.32）。實際排名先看 Project 平均（a1-a8），其中 a1、a2 與 a4 最具決定性，再以 Wiki 平均（w1-w5）作為第二順位，在 Project 分數接近時用來分出高下。Presentation 納入後，接近的名次可能翻轉。評分尺度的最高標準是 GreatBay_SZ 2019 與 TAS Taipei 2017（p.32-35、p.102-104），而對高中隊伍來說，做出一個特性充分的可運作 Part 就是相當了不起的成就（p.101）。J2 最先看 DBTL（a4）、標準與模組化（a7），以及成果離開實驗室後是否站得住腳。當結果只是被宣稱、模型或計畫而非實測、模型只是裝飾，或零件只記錄在 Wiki 上（p.18）時，分數會下降。誠信問題應交由 RCC 處理（p.25）。

J3.en: J3, who covers HP, bioethics and science education, reads it the same way: finalists are the highest-ranking teams on Project, Wiki and Presentation, by a weighted average within each section, and High School gets 2 (p.12, Step 8; p.28). Project is "the main determinant" (p.31), so J3 ranks on the Project average (a1-a8) and uses the Wiki average (w1-w5) within about 0.3. Presentation and a9 are not assessed, and J3 notes the missing Presentation could reorder two close teams. A 5 is pegged to GreatBay_SZ 2019 or TAS Taipei 2017 (p.32-35, p.102-104); a working Part with controls is 4-level on a2 (p.101). J3 looks first at whether stakeholder input really changed the design (a5, p.21-23), honest attribution (a6) and citations (w5), but scores a2, a4, a7 and a8 as hard. Scores fall when HP changed nothing (a5 at most 3), when no measured data exist (a2 at most 2.5), when bench work is unattributed, or when evidence is only modelled or planned. Parts data belongs on the Registry (p.18). Integrity flags go to the RCC (p.94-95).
J3.zh: J3 的專長是 HP、生物倫理與科學教育，對手冊的解讀相同：決賽隊伍是在 Project、Wiki 與 Presentation 上排名最高的隊伍，在各組別內以加權平均計算，High School 組有 2 支（p.12，Step 8；p.28）。Project 是「決定決賽隊伍的主要因素」（p.31），因此 J3 以 Project 平均（a1-a8）排名，並在差距約 0.3 以內時用 Wiki 平均（w1-w5）區分隊伍。Presentation 與 a9 不予評分，J3 也坦白說明，缺少 Presentation 可能使兩支接近的隊伍名次對調。5 分的標準對應 GreatBay_SZ 2019 或 TAS Taipei 2017（p.32-35、p.102-104）；一個有對照組且可運作的 Part，在 a2 上已屬 4 分等級的表現（p.101）。J3 最先看利害關係人的意見是否真的改變了設計（a5，p.21-23）、貢獻歸屬是否誠實（a6）以及引用文獻（w5），但對 a2、a4、a7 與 a8 的評分同樣嚴格。當 HP 沒有改變任何設計（a5 最高 3 分）、沒有實測數據（a2 最高 2.5 分）、實驗操作歸屬不明，或證據僅為模型或計畫時，分數會下降。零件資料必須放在 Registry 上（p.18）。誠信疑慮應通報 RCC（p.94-95）。
